checks/independent/comp-finite-model-con.role: Bounded finite-word verification application integrating immutable rewrite-system ownership, shortest-path and trace certificates, conservative resource accounting, typed refusals and six finite computation controls
checks/independent/comp-finite-model-con.cost: Alphabet <=32, rules <=32, words <=64 symbols, retained search states <=4096, reserved rule-offset trials <=65536. Each trial compares/copies at most 128 symbols before filtering to 64. Search memory O(states * word length); trace snapshot <=4096 *64 symbols, then bounded rule trials. Helper naturals <=4096 bits. Default receipt executes 50 obligations.

groups.requirement: Own a frozen alphabet and distinct nested rule snapshots. Admit 1..32 distinct symbols in 0..4095, <=32 rules, words <=64 symbols and max_length 0..64. Empty rule sides are valid. Reject bool/float, malformed shapes, unknown symbols and over-budget sequences before use.

Validate an exact one-hole context and rule index, returning its replacement under the global 64-symbol admission limit. apply is a raw witness operation: search max_length is enforced separately. Ordered successor enumeration includes empty-left insertion at the final position and only emits words within max_length.

Breadth-first search returns an owned shortest path, successful None only for completed bounded exhaustion or an out-of-bound target, or a typed input/resource refusal. Validate source/target/budgets before identity. At most 4096 retained states and 65536 rule-offset trials; reserve each expansion before doing work, include the initial state, never overwrite a visited parent and return on first goal discovery.

Snapshot a nonempty trace of <=4096 admitted in-bound words. Each adjacent pair must be an actual rule step, including repeated words only when a self-step exists. Reserve bounded rule-offset work before each transition and distinguish malformed input, invalid witness and exhausted resource.

Preserve the literal merge, halted writer, constant evaluation, finite pair encoding and blank-extension definitions. Naturals admit up to 4096 bits; encoded word symbols up to 4095. Validate all parameters even those ignored by a selected branch. An already halted cell keeps its old value; blank extension owns a new list with total length <=64.

Compose the six original finite controls into 50 unique executed obligations: 5 word moves, 5 no-rule bound controls, 25 writer controls, 6 encoding controls, 2 erasures and 7 tape controls. Preserve exact failure names/counts, per-invocation state, typed CLI diagnostics, nonzero failure exit and cancellation propagation. No claim about infinite reductions, full TM simulation or minimality.

checks/independent/comp-finite-model-con.consumer_boundary: The six retired executable entry paths are intentionally removed and mapped to byte-preserved archives. Historical DAG/review references keep their original provenance. Current regression loads the composed application and current workflow runs its suite. Default combined receipt uses 50 executed obligations; old six receipt schemas remain historical. Public source loader remains restricted to the current named alphabetical population.

checks/tests/test_computation_controls.p.role: Independent finite-graph verification application with separately formulated context and fixed-point oracles, generated properties, resource and lifecycle challenges and six-control integration
checks/tests/test_computation_controls.p.cost: 16 test groups, 80 deterministic cases per generated property. Independent context oracle admits binary words of length <=3 (15 words), <=4 rules and finite Cartesian context enumeration. Boundary tests use <=4097 trace rows and <=4096-bit values. Context-managed mocks/captures and isolated import ownership restore resources.

groups.requirement: Independent context-based graph edges and layer fixed-point distances cross-check production scanning/BFS. Explicit oracle metatests, failure-helper metatest, boundary/snapshot cases, generated functional and receipt properties and failure/cancellation tests reject semantic and lifecycle faults.

checks/tests/test_review_repairs.py.role: Integrated independent regression application with restricted/restored source loading, separate exact oracles, typed-refusal checking and bounded subprocess verification through dfm-continuum-refinement-limit
checks/tests/test_review_repairs.py.cost: Each of 20 isolated subprocesses has a 45-second limit. Deterministic enumerations include 8200 lineon paths, 1920 projector/vector cases and 380 graph cuts times 64 assignments; no input-controlled population. Import registry and capture contexts restore on failure/cancellation.

groups.requirement: Load only reviewed local sources, restore sys.modules during success/errors/cancellation and preserve results while capturing output.
Independent collision oracle rejects coincidence and sign-crossing for simultaneous integer hops in the enumerated fixtures.

Provide one unittest suite with explicit failure helpers, independent arithmetic/finite enumerations, negative-path refusals and isolated CLI integration. Individual method names state each tested requirement; successful outcomes are never treated as typed refusals.

checks/tests/test_review_repairs.py.migration: Six computation sources compose to one, reducing the named alphabetical population from 25 to 20. Only header, expected population and C2/C7 shared-hole loading changed; the 24 groups and their assertions otherwise remain intact. Existing loader lifecycle/oracle mutation evidence is retained with old source hashes, not represented as a new campaign.
